prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the supplied eight-frame cartoon dung-beetle sprite sheet. The user explicitly requests a REALISTIC version, not a cartoon.
Replace all eight cartoon beetles and balls with photorealistic natural dung beetles rolling fibrous brown dung balls. Preserve only the production layout: exactly eight separate animation cels in four columns and two rows, wide 2:1 canvas, consistent scale and positions. Completely replace the cartoon design and expressions.
VISUAL STYLE: ultra-realistic natural-history macro photography, focus-stacked so all of each beetle and ball is sharp. Genuine insect proportions and materials: oval domed ridged elytra with fine punctures, segmented head and pronotum, six articulated spiny insect legs with natural tarsal claws, small dark compound eyes, short lamellate antennae. Fine dust on chitin, subtle scuffs, restrained specular highlights. Absolutely no human face, eyebrows, eyeball whites, smile, teeth, tongue, hands, biceps, decorative markings, logo, glowing lines, clay texture, plastic toy appearance or anthropomorphic body proportions.
ANATOMICAL ACTION: realistic dung-rolling posture. Beetle stays on LEFT of ball, head facing LEFT and abdomen toward ball on RIGHT. Hind legs extend backward to press against the ball while forelegs and middle legs step on the implied ground, moving the beetle and ball to the RIGHT. Low, effortful insect posture, not a person pushing with hands. The beetle remains fully visible; the ball never covers the body. Ball is a roughly spherical mass of dark earthy dung with rough compacted fibers and tiny straw fragments, roughly as tall as the insect's torso plus legs, no spiral poop emoji, no polished rock.
ANIMATION: eight sequential different poses of one consistent beetle's backward walking/rolling cycle. Alternating leg contacts and natural slight body shift, same shell shape and camera throughout. Ball texture rotates clockwise a little in every frame while its center, size and silhouette stay stable. No lateral translation within tiles. Frame8 flows back to frame1, no duplicate end frame.
COMPOSITION: retain a regular 4x2 atlas; aim for 2048x1024 PNG with 512x512 invisible cells, wide aspect ratio2:1. Each cell shows exactly one complete beetle-ball pair, with abundant truly transparent padding, no cropped legs or antennae, matching ground baseline. Side-on view with slight top visibility, consistent neutral soft natural illumination. Whole subject inside local cell x40..472, y150..420. Do not draw the grid.
TRANSPARENCY IS ESSENTIAL: all empty background and floor pixels must be truly transparent alpha0. Insect and ball interiors opaque alpha255, antialiased contours. NO white studio paper, gray floor, colored background, mist, checkerboard, cast shadow, drop shadow, glow or stray edge pixels. No text, numbers, labels, scenery or extra props. The background must be a clean cutout, usable immediately on desktop wallpaper.
COLOR VARIANT — CHATGPT CODEX: near-black graphite chitin with subtle natural emerald-green/teal iridescent reflections on the ridges, black legs and dark compound eyes. Cool green highlights should feel like real metallic insect armor, not neon lines, paint or LEDs. Earthy dung ball remains natural dark brown.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this realistic eight-frame dung-beetle sprite sheet. Create the matching CLAUDE CODE color variant.
Change ONLY the beetles' shell coloration: replace the cool green/teal iridescence with natural warm copper, terracotta-bronze and reddish-brown metallic chitin. The shell must look like real burnished insect armor with tiny punctures and ridges, not painted plastic. Dark chestnut legs. Keep the natural compound eyes small and dark, no expressions or anthropomorphic features. No logos, white ornament, markings, words or clothing.
Preserve ALL geometry, all eight exact leg poses, body proportions, textures, cameras, lighting, size, position, sharpness, every brown fibrous dung ball, and the precise four-column two-row layout. Preserve the wide 1774x887 (2:1) canvas and cell spacing. No reframing or cropping.
Preserve transparent alpha outside the eight beetle-ball cutouts and REMOVE any barely visible loose colored matte noise. Empty background pixels must be truly transparent alpha0 and RGB0, not near-transparent alpha1 or2; no white/red/yellow fringe, no colored haze. Object interiors should be opaque with clean smooth antialiased silhouettes. No shadows or background additions. Final result is the same photo-realistic sprite atlas with only copper-bronze vendor coloration changed.
